claude.performance_metric: FY2012 revenue $3.12bn, net income $211.0m; no goodwill impairment; headcount ~1,500 → ~4,000
claude.rationale: On the product/process interface, the slice documents no realized product-operations incoherence: the EchoStar Technologies segment continued to supply set-top boxes and digital broadcast operations, the Hughes acquisition passed its 2012 step-one goodwill test (not impaired), and the entity remained profitable, so p4 is coded 0. On the process/organization interface, the record shows headcount tripling to ~4,000 and continued reliance on DISH Network management/administrative personnel with no documented realized fracture; the Hughes integration language ("complex," culture differences "may affect" retention) is forward-looking risk-factor caution, not a documented realized disruption, so p5 is coded 0. No documented archetype incoherence or business-model incompatibility in the realized record, so t1 and t2 are 0.

grok.performance_metric: remained profitable; FY2012 NI $211M on $3.12bn revenue
grok.rationale: The slice documents continued product delivery (set-top boxes and digital broadcast ops primarily to DISH under a 2012–2014 cost-plus receiver agreement) with growing segment/total revenue and no product-line/operations incoherence, so p4_pathway=0. On process/organization, headcount rose to ~4,000, legacy segment leadership continued, and DISH management/admin services agreements persisted; Hughes integration is disclosed only as potential complexity/culture risk, not a realized fracture, so p5_pathway=0.

openai.rationale: No realized product/process disruption is documented: EchoStar Technologies continued providing set-top boxes and digital broadcast operations, primarily to DISH Network, and generated ongoing segment revenue [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-13-011985, Form 10-K (FY2012)]. No realized process/organization fracture is documented: headcount reached approximately 4,000 and segment operating leadership remained in place; the Hughes integration discussion described potential disruption, employee loss, and cultural differences as risks rather than realized outcomes [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-13-011985, Form 10-K (FY2012)].
